QUOTE: "`TimerProc` / `sighandler` (benchmark) | Windows timer thread, and a POSIX alarm handler, in the benchmark tool only."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the benchmark has a Windows timer thread but never says it is gated on a platform condition (e.g. `_WIN32`) rather than on the threading config. The `_WIN32` gate it mentions is for `term_handler`, not the benchmark timer.
